text: {"status": "answered", "answer": "Under the Overdraft Policy v3, Harbor charges a fee of $29 per item paid through Courtesy Pay, up to a maximum of three items per business day. No overdraft fee is charged if the account is overdrawn by $25.00 or less at the end of the business day. If you use Overdraft Transfer Protection to transfer funds from a linked Primary Share Account, there's a $5.00 transfer fee per business day (only one fee is charged per day regardless of how many items the transfer covers).", "cited_chunk_ids": ["overdraft_policy_v3::layout::B_structure::0004"], "reason": "The Overdraft Policy v3 clearly defines the overdraft fees for retail checking accounts, which is the member's tenant type."}
